brief.goal: Get new customers in the door (drive foot traffic/visits to a clothing store), and drive online purchases via QR code
brief.desiredRecipientAction: Visit the store in person, and/or scan a QR code to visit the website and make a purchase

primarySuccessMetric.description: In-store visits from neighborhood residents receiving the postcard

transcript.content: I want to send 1,000 postcards to this neighborhood.

Nice, a 1,000-postcard neighborhood drop is a great way to build local awareness. Let's nail down the purpose first: what's the main goal of this campaign — something like getting new customers in the door, promoting a specific offer, announcing something new, or building brand awareness?
getting new customers in the door

Got it — driving new customers through the door is a great focus for a neighborhood mailer. What kind of business is this for, and what would you like recipients to actually do when they get the postcard — call you, visit your location, scan a QR code, redeem a coupon, something else?
this is for a clothing store

Great, a clothing store — that's a fun one to design for. Now, what would you like the postcard to actually get people to do: visit the store in person, bring in a coupon, scan a QR code for an online offer, or something else?
i want them to come visit the store and scan the QR code to drive traffic to my site and make a purchase

Perfect — so this postcard has two goals: getting people into your store, and driving traffic to your site via QR code for purchases. That's a great combo.\n\nA few things I'll need to make this work: what's the store's name, address, and website (or the page you want the QR code to link to)? And is there an offer or incentive — like a discount or a free gift — that would give people a reason to come in or scan the code?
